home.lead: Map how someone's circumstances connect — money, housing, work, school, family, safety — and see which ones feed each other.

first_run.title: Before you start
first_run.body: This is a thinking tool for mapping how a person's or a group's social circumstances connect. It describes circumstances using codes from the World Health Organization's ICD-11; it does not diagnose anyone, give medical, legal or financial advice, or replace a professional who knows the situation. Everything you type stays in this browser on this device unless you export it.

codes.no_definition: No definition in ICD-11 for this code.
codes.open_who: Open in the WHO ICD-11 browser
codes.interim: Text from a copy of ICD-11 (release 2026-01). Check the WHO entry for the official wording.
codes.assign_for_associations: Assign an SDOH code to see associations.

associations.title: What the research links to this

grade.S: Strong: systematic review or large cohort

associations.tiers_note: Ordered from structural to intermediary determinants (the builder's reading of the WHO framework).

edges.weight_help: Your judgement of strength, −1 to +1. Not a measured effect.

loops.title: Loops
loops.strength_label: Loop strength — structural heuristic, not loop dominance
loops.none: No loops yet. A loop forms when arrows lead back to where they started.
loops.truncated: Too many loops to list them all; showing the first 500.

analyses.paths_title: How does one circumstance affect another?
analyses.pulse_label: What-if pulse — qualitative exploration, not prediction

privacy.saved_here: Saved in this browser on this device only — export to keep a copy.
privacy.clear_confirm: Delete every map stored in this browser? This cannot be undone.

deidentify: Use initials or a label. Don't enter names, dates of birth, addresses or record numbers.
